cells-only.name: cell
cells-only.description: Runs a cell: typescript code in this session's persistent kernel (top-level await; declarations persist across cells). Start it with a `// intent: <what and why>` line. The `fx` global reaches the workspace (files, commands); `await fx.finish(result)` ends the turn. The result shows what the cell printed and the value of its last expression, bounded.

code.description: The cell's code; its first line is `// intent: <what and why>`.

hybrid.name: cell
hybrid.description: Runs a cell: typescript code in this session's persistent kernel (top-level await; declarations persist across cells). Start it with a `// intent: <what and why>` line. The `fx` global reaches the workspace (files, commands); `await fx.finish(result)` ends the turn. The result shows what the cell printed and the value of its last expression, bounded.

code.description: The cell's code; its first line is `// intent: <what and why>`.

hybrid.name: read
hybrid.description: Reads a text file of the workspace, with line numbers (use offset and limit for long files). Files that content exclusions keep from models are refused.

hybrid.name: edit
hybrid.description: Edits a text file of the workspace: replaces `old` (which must occur exactly once, unless `all`) with `new`. Copy `old` from the file as read, without the line numbers.

old.description: The text to replace, exactly as in the file (without line numbers).

new.description: The text to put in its place.

all.description: Replace every occurrence; otherwise `old` must occur exactly once.

hybrid.name: bash
hybrid.description: Runs a command line in the workspace with its shell (sh; PowerShell 7 on Windows) and returns its exit code and output (the head and tail of each stream).

timeoutMs.description: Kills the command after this many milliseconds.
